# decode_pqtl_signals_v

One row per deCODE plasma pQTL pseudo credible set (dataset deCODE_pQTL_2021 in
credible_sets_v), carrying the set's lead variant and `window_top`: whether that lead is the
strongest lead of the same aptamer within ±2 Mb. This view exists because the deCODE sets
were LD-clumped against the Finnish FinnGen R12 panel. That panel cannot separate an LD
shadow of a strong pQTL from an independent signal, so a single cis-pQTL at -log10 p in the
thousands leaves hundreds of sets around it, most of them single-variant sets with pip 0.99.
Of 130,685 sets, 26,904 are window tops (median 4 per aptamer, against 3.7 primary
associations per aptamer in the paper). COUNTING SIGNALS: count `WHERE window_top`, never
raw credible sets, for any question such as "how many pQTLs", "how many trans signals",
"independent instruments for MR" or "coloc inputs". A set that is not a window top names the
stronger lead it sits next to (stronger_cs_id, stronger_mlog10p, stronger_distance). A
window top is not proof of independence either: shadows of the very strongest cis-pQTLs
reach past 2 Mb (206 window tops lie 2-5 Mb from a lead of -log10 p >= 1000 in the same
aptamer), and only deCODE's own conditional analysis separates secondary signals. VARIANTS:
this view has one row per set, not per variant. Join back to credible_sets_v on (dataset,
trait_original, cs_id) for the members. The lead is the variant cs_id names, not necessarily
the max-pip row. COST: a view with no base table that groups the deCODE rows of
credible_sets on every query, about 1.1 GB scanned; it reports no row count.

## Columns

| column | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataset` | `STRING` | Always deCODE_pQTL_2021 |
| `data_type` | `STRING` | Always pQTL |
| `trait` | `STRING` | Gene symbol of the aptamer's target protein (the aptamer id where it has none) |
| `trait_original` | `STRING` | SomaScan aptamer id (seq.NNNN.NN); the window comparison is per aptamer |
| `cell_type` | `STRING` | Always plasma |
| `cs_id` | `STRING` | Pseudo credible set id, the lead variant as chr<chr>_<pos>_<ref>_<alt>. Unique within (dataset, trait_original) |
| `cs_size` | `INT64` | Number of variants in the set |
| `chr` | `INT64` | Chromosome of the lead, X is 23 |
| `pos` | `INT64` | Lead position (GRCh38) |
| `ref` | `STRING` | Lead reference allele |
| `alt` | `STRING` | Lead alternative (effect) allele |
| `variant` | `STRING` | Lead variant as chr:pos:ref:alt, chromosome X is 23 |
| `mlog10p` | `FLOAT64` | -log10(p) of the lead |
| `window_top` | `BOOL` | TRUE when no lead of the same aptamer on the same chromosome within ±2 Mb has a larger mlog10p. Count signals with this |
| `stronger_cs_id` | `STRING` | When window_top is FALSE: cs_id of the strongest lead of the same aptamer within ±2 Mb. NULL for a window top |
| `stronger_mlog10p` | `FLOAT64` | mlog10p of that stronger lead. NULL for a window top |
| `stronger_distance` | `INT64` | Distance in bp from this lead to that stronger lead. NULL for a window top |
| `resource` | `STRING` | Data source identifier, always 'decode' |

## Worked examples

Queries that run against decode_pqtl_signals_v as written.

### pQTL signals per protein, counted as window tops rather than raw credible sets

```sql
SELECT trait, trait_original, COUNTIF(window_top) AS signals, COUNT(*) AS credible_sets FROM decode_pqtl_signals_v WHERE trait = 'IL6R' GROUP BY trait, trait_original
```

### Variants of the independent-looking deCODE pQTL signals for one protein, joined back to credible_sets_v for their members

```sql
SELECT c.trait, c.cs_id, c.variant, c.mlog10p, c.beta, c.se, c.pip FROM decode_pqtl_signals_v s JOIN credible_sets_v c USING (dataset, trait_original, cs_id) WHERE s.trait = 'PCSK9' AND s.window_top
  AND c.resource = 'decode' AND c.data_type = 'pQTL'
ORDER BY c.cs_id, c.pip DESC
```
